assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons use repository provisional boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are valid only for local design discussion and must be recomputed when official boundary data are released.
assumptions.data_needed: Official CAD/GIS/PDF boundary and key-area polygons with CRS and publication metadata.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and heritage controls are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity, building scale, costs and implementation commitments remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use public, authorized, aggregated or synthetic test data unless a future operator obtains lawful consent and review.
assumptions.impact: Scenario deployment requires privacy, security and human-review protocols.

assumptions.statement: Construction costs are not estimated with exact figures.
assumptions.impact: Costs require official scope, quantities, procurement model and engineering conditions.

assumptions.statement: 43.6 km² is treated as the broader coordinated research area, while ≈11.4 km² is the submitted provisional geometry used for design layers and metric recomputation.
assumptions.impact: Human-facing materials must explain the two levels together so reviewers do not read them as conflicting boundaries.
assumptions.data_needed: Official scope hierarchy, CAD/GIS boundary files and any organizer-issued clarification.

assumptions.statement: Every urban AI service must pass Problem Intake, Calibration, Release Gate and Civic Verification before scale; conditional cases return to recalibration and failures trigger rollback or retirement.
assumptions.impact: This is an institutional design proposal, not an approved regulatory procedure.
assumptions.data_needed: Future operator mandates, legal review, public participation rules, data governance protocol and third-party evaluation contract.

assumptions.statement: The AI Retirement / Rollback Node publicly records stopped systems, reasons, evidence, decision body, alternatives, data handling and reapplication conditions.
assumptions.impact: The node is a public accountability mechanism and requires governance authorization before operation.
assumptions.data_needed: Confirmed operator registry, appeal workflow, evidence publication rules, privacy retention schedule and emergency service fallback plan.

assumptions.statement: The proposal derives spatial roles from official task descriptions and public park/transit sources, but does not possess parcel, ownership, road-redline or building-survey data.
assumptions.impact: Site-specific strategies are concept-level urban design moves and need measured base maps before implementation.
assumptions.data_needed: Official CAD/GIS, station-area survey, road sections, pedestrian counts, public-space use survey, building inventory and ownership data.

assumptions.statement: V5 limits detailed design to a station-west Dazhongsi pedestrian study window derived from mapped roads, railway, buildings and pedestrian space; exact entrances, access rights, gradients, bicycle parking and interchange works are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: The three pedestrian links are conflict-checked conceptual alignments, not approved station-access engineering.
assumptions.data_needed: Subway station drawings, access-right and entrance records, measured gradients, tactile-paving audit, pedestrian flow, bicycle parking inventory and traffic-safety review.

assumptions.statement: The proposal uses a BBBike OpenStreetMap Beijing extract dated 2026-08-08 for overall context and a 2026-08-15 OSM Map API window for detailed Dazhongsi conflict checks.
assumptions.impact: OSM is a traceable public basemap, not an official survey, road redline, station drawing, cadastral boundary or complete building inventory.
assumptions.data_needed: Organizer-cleared survey/CAD/GIS, station engineering drawings, road redlines and building inventory.

assumptions.statement: The mapped OSM Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park lies roughly 0.4 km west of the nearest edge of the repository provisional site geometry in the middle segment.
assumptions.impact: Figures show both layers; formal site metrics remain tied to repository provisional geometry, and no claim is made that the dashed polygon is the railway park redline.
assumptions.data_needed: Official aligned project boundary and park/rail heritage GIS with coordinate reference metadata.

assumptions.statement: The building layer is a selected set of OSM existing-context candidates, not a complete existing inventory and not proposed construction.
assumptions.impact: No demolition, retention, structural condition, ownership, height or development-capacity conclusion is made from the footprints.
assumptions.data_needed: Measured building survey, use/condition/height inventory, ownership and fire/structure assessment.

assumptions.statement: V5 locates a roughly 8.7 ha Release-to-Retirement demonstration district west of the OSM-mapped Dazhongsi station and treats the repository Dazhongsi key-area polygon as a conflicting provisional placeholder rather than a physical station redline.
assumptions.impact: The district route avoids all buildings in the downloaded OSM window, but station entrances, access rights, gradients, paving, crossings and pedestrian capacity still require official engineering and field data.
assumptions.data_needed: Official station coordinates/drawings, entrance and interchange data, road redlines, access-right evidence, measured section survey, pedestrian counts and traffic-safety review.

assumptions.statement: Rollback and retirement memory form one station-edge sequence: a roughly 535 m² rail-parallel shaded daily-use walk with ordinary seating, tactile durable archive strips, non-screen notice slots and a staffed appeal/repair table.
assumptions.impact: The proposal is a reversible public-space prototype, not an approved facility, a digital-screen installation or a claim about a specific surviving railway artifact.
assumptions.data_needed: Measured public-space and tree survey, access rights, heritage review, archive governance, accessibility design and operator agreement.

assumptions.statement: V5 reaches competition-level conceptual urban-design specification on a public basemap, with detailed conflict-checked design concentrated in the Dazhongsi demonstration district; it is not statutory planning, survey-grade detailed design or construction documentation.
assumptions.impact: Matrix completeness means the required response is evidenced and its limitation is disclosed; it does not assert official planning completion.
assumptions.data_needed: Formal base map, parcels, access rights, station engineering, measured sections, controls, utilities, heritage boundaries, traffic survey and costed engineering design.
